MrBeast.text: His early uploads included estimates of other YouTubers' wealth.
MrBeast.evidence: His early uploads ranged from Let's Play videos to estimations of other YouTubers' wealth.

T-Series.text: Founder Gulshan Kumar was a Delhi fruit juice seller who started out selling pirated Hindi songs.
T-Series.evidence: Kumar, initially a fruit juice seller in Delhi, founded T-Series to sell pirated Hindi songs before the company eventually began producing new music.

Cocomelon - Nursery Rhymes.text: It started in 2006 under the username "checkgate", a month before Google acquired YouTube.
Cocomelon - Nursery Rhymes.evidence: On September 1, 2006, Cocomelon was created on YouTube under the username "checkgate", a month before Google acquired YouTube.

SET India.text: In 2006 it aired Bigg Boss, an adaptation of Big Brother, before the show moved to Colors TV.
SET India.evidence: In 2006, Sony made an adaptation of the reality show Big Brother, Bigg Boss. It also made an adaptation of American show Fear Factor, Fear Factor India, but all these shows were moved to Colors TV.

Vlad and Niki.text: In 2019 the brothers were judged the YouTubers making the most per video, about US$312,000 each.
Vlad and Niki.evidence: In 2019, the brothers were judged to be the YouTubers making the most money per video at an estimated US$312,000 per video.

Stokes Twins.text: Early on they lived in their car for about eighteen months, showering at public gyms.
Stokes Twins.evidence: For roughly eighteen months they lived in their car, showered at public gyms, and uploaded 6-second sketches to Instagram before pivoting to YouTube.

Kids Diana Show.text: Her parents began filming as a hobby when her brother Roma was born, then quit their jobs for YouTube in 2017.
Kids Diana Show.evidence: Olena and Volodymyr Kydysiuk started making YouTube videos as a hobby when Diana's brother, Roma, was born. ... In 2017, both parents left their jobs to focus full-time on their YouTube channel.

김프로KIMPRO.text: The channel was started in 2017, but its first video was not uploaded until August 2022.
김프로KIMPRO.evidence: KIMPRO started its channel on 11 November 2017; the channel's first video was uploaded in August 2022.

Like Nastya.text: She was diagnosed with cerebral palsy at birth, causing fears that she would not be able to speak.
Like Nastya.evidence: At birth, she was diagnosed with cerebral palsy, causing fears that she would not be able to speak.

Alejo Igoa.text: He started his channel in 2014 after his parents gave him a camera as a birthday present.
Alejo Igoa.evidence: He created his YouTube channel in 2014, uploading his first video Solo Se Vos Mismo (lit. 'Just Be Yourself') after having received a camera as a birthday present from his parents.
